name: Best Friends Pet Adoption Center - NYC
neighborhoods: Manhattan (SoHo) center; all 5 boroughs + Tri-State reach
notes: The New York centre of the national no-kill charity Best Friends Animal Society: its Pet Adoption Center at 307 West Broadway, SoHo, open every day 11am-7pm. Cats are on site every day; most dogs live in foster homes, so ring ahead to meet a particular dog. Works with ACC and local rescues, and runs spay/neuter and shelter-support programmes. It does not take owner surrenders unless the animal was adopted from Best Friends.

NYC center of the national 501(c)(3) Best Friends Animal Society, 307 W Broadway, SoHo 10013, open daily 11-7. Cats on-site daily; most DOGS are in foster homes, so CALL AHEAD to meet a specific dog. Works collaboratively with ACC + local rescues. Cannot take owner surrenders (unless previously adopted from them) but provides keep-your-pet resources + partner referrals. Also offers spay/neuter referrals + behavior guidance. Phone: (no public adoption phone; contact via site) Email: (via site contact form) Intake: open daily 11am-7pm
